name: Booloo v0.7.0
body:
Booloo 轻量桌宠：内置布噜 / Bulu，可导入自己的图片，在桌面上陪伴与互动。

- 摸头、摸背、双击与长按互动，眨眼及真实动作动画。
- 好感度成长、点击热力图、健康计划及待办提醒。
- 22 枚成就徽章：互动、好感、陪伴与照顾里程碑，记录页可查看进度。
- 本地自动抠图与手动微调，中英文界面。
- 保留 Tauri 版的数据与更新标识；正式版迁移旧开机启动项，Windows 安装器迁移旧快捷方式。

Booloo is a lightweight desktop companion featuring Bulu, image import,
petting and gesture reactions, friendship growth, wellness reminders,
a click heatmap, 22 achievement badges, local cutout editing, and
Chinese / English UI. Existing Tauri settings and the signed update
channel are preserved.

macOS: `Booloo_x.y.z_aarch64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) / `Booloo_x.y.z_x64.dmg` (Intel) — unsigned builds need right-click → Open the first time.
Auto-update is available from v0.5.1 onwards.

name: Prismoo v0.5.0 (Tauri 2.0)
body:
Prismoo 从 Electron 迁移到了 Tauri 2 + Rust。核心功能保持一致，体积大幅下降。

|  | 之前 (Electron 0.4.0) | 现在 (Tauri 0.5.0) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| 安装包 | 139.6 MB | **8.6 MB** |
| 可执行文件 | 188 MB | **11.3 MB** |

**这一版做了什么**

- 后端从 Node/Electron 重写为 Rust；前端（Canvas 动画、设置面板、对话窗口）几乎原样复用
- 窗口、托盘、右键菜单、配置、会话存储、AI 请求、天气、开机自启、自定义外观全部迁移完成
- 新增三阶段自检：`npm run tauri:check`（宠物渲染 / 设置读写 / 聊天会话增删改查）

**暂未提供**

- 自动更新尚未接入，本版**不会**自动升级
- 3D 模型皮肤、基于 ONNX 的本地抠图（迁移时按计划移除）
- 目前只在 Windows 上完整验证过，macOS / Linux 待测试

> ⚠️ 配置文件目录变更为 `%APPDATA%\com.petric.desktop-pet\`，旧版（`%APPDATA%\Prismoo\`）的设置与对话历史不会自动继承。

---

Prismoo has moved from Electron to Tauri 2 + Rust. Same core features, far smaller footprint.

|  | Before (Electron 0.4.0) | Now (Tauri 0.5.0) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Installer | 139.6 MB | **8.6 MB** |
| Executable | 188 MB | **11.3 MB** |

**What changed**

- Backend rewritten in Rust; the front end (Canvas animation, settings panel, chat window) is reused almost unchanged
- Window, tray, context menu, config, chat store, AI requests, weather, auto-launch and custom appearance all migrated
- New three-phase self-check: `npm run tauri:check` (pet render / settings read-write / chat CRUD)

**Not available yet**

- Auto-update is not wired up — this build does **not** self-update
- 3D model skins and the ONNX local cutout (removed by design during the migration)
- Only fully verified on Windows; macOS / Linux still need testing

> ⚠️ The config directory changed to `%APPDATA%\com.petric.desktop-pet\`; settings and chat history from the old build (`%APPDATA%\Prismoo\`) are not carried over.

name: Prismoo
body:
# Prismoo v0.4.0 发版说明

> Petric 正式更名为 **Prismoo**。老用户直接覆盖安装即可，设置、聊天记录与自定义宠物会自动沿用，不会丢失。

---

## ✨ 新版本亮点

### 🐾 名称更新：Petric → Prismoo

- 应用更名并启用全新视觉：新图标、新品牌图、界面与文案全面更新
- 安装包文件名更新为 `Prismoo-Setup-x.y.z.exe`（应用 ID 保持不变，可直接覆盖升级）
- 升级安装会自动沿用旧版 Petric 的用户数据目录，设置 / 聊天记录 / 自定义宠物无需重新配置

### 🔄 更新体验大升级

- 设置面板新增「更新」专区，并显示当前版本号
- 可开关「启动时检查更新」「自动下载新版本」，可选稳定版 / 预览版更新渠道
- 检查、下载进度、就绪状态全程可见，支持查看更新日志
- 支持「立即检查 / 下载更新 / 重启更新 / 打开下载页」一键操作
- 检查失败自动按 30 分钟 → 2 小时 → 24 小时退避重试
- 选择「稍后再说」后，24 小时内不再打扰同一版本；下次退出时自动完成更新

### 🔐 更安全的本地配置

- API Key 改为使用操作系统安全存储加密后落盘（macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI / Linux Keyring）
- 配置写入改为原子写入 + 防抖合并，退出前自动冲刷，降低配置损坏风险

---

## 🚀 性能与稳定性

- 自定义外观改为流式资源协议加载：超大 3D 模型不再以 base64 跨进程传输，加载更快、内存占用更低
- 宠物命中检测改为按需重建，GPU 回读频率大幅降低；鼠标划过透明窗口不再让宠物一直保持清醒
- 新增系统守护：拔插显示器 / 切换分辨率 / 系统休眠恢复后，宠物自动回到可见屏幕范围内
- 修复截图相关图片显示问题

---

## 🧰 安装与更新

- Windows：`Prismoo-Setup-0.4.0.exe`
- macOS / Linux：请前往 GitHub Releases 下载对应安装包
- 未签名版本首次运行时，Windows SmartScreen 可能提示“未知发布者”，点击「更多信息 → 仍要运行」即可
- 自动更新仅对打包安装版生效；使用中遇到问题欢迎到仓库提交 Issue

感谢每一位贡献者与用户的支持！

---

# Prismoo v0.4.0 Release Notes

> Petric is now **Prismoo**. Existing users can simply install over the previous version — settings, chat history, and custom pets carry over automatically.

---

## ✨ What’s New

### 🐾 Rename: Petric → Prismoo

- New name, new icon and brand assets, refreshed UI copy across the whole app
- Installer renamed to `Prismoo-Setup-x.y.z.exe` (the app ID is unchanged, so it upgrades existing installs in place)
- Upgrade installs automatically reuse the legacy Petric data directory — no need to reconfigure settings, chats, or custom pets

### 🔄 A Much Better Update Experience

- New “Updates” section in Settings, with the current version shown in the header
- Toggle “check on startup” and “auto-download”, and choose between Stable and Prerelease channels
- Full visibility of check / download / ready states, with release notes viewable in-app
- One-click actions: check now, download, restart & update, or open the release page
- Failed checks retry automatically with backoff (30 min → 2 h → 24 h)
- Choosing “Later” silences the same version for 24 hours; the update is applied at the next app quit

### 🔐 Safer Local Configuration

- API keys are now encrypted at rest with the OS secure storage (macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI / Linux Keyring)
- Config saves use atomic writes with debounce merging, flushed on quit — lowering the risk of a corrupted config

---

## 🚀 Performance & Stability

- Custom appearances now load through a streaming resource scheme: large 3D models no longer cross the IPC bridge as base64 — faster to load, lower memory usage
- Per-pixel pet hit-testing is rebuilt lazily, drastically reducing GPU readbacks; a cursor sweeping across the transparent window no longer keeps the pet awake
- System watchdogs: after monitors are added/removed, resolution changes, or the system resumes from sleep, the pet is automatically brought back to a visible screen
- Fixed screenshot display issues in the docs

---

## 🧰 Installation & Updates

- Windows: `Prismoo-Setup-0.4.0.exe`
- macOS / Linux: grab the matching package from GitHub Releases
- Unsigned builds may trigger a Windows SmartScreen “unknown publisher” warning — choose “More info → Run anyway”
- Auto-update only applies to installed packaged builds; feel free to open an Issue if you run into anything

Thanks to every contributor and user!

name: Desk-Petrick v0.2.0
body:
📌 v0.2.0 — 全新宠物形象 · AI 自动抠图 · 生活助手 · 性能大优化
✨ 亮点

全新默认宠物：内置 3 只全新角色（🐱 猫 / 🦊 狐狸 / 🐰 兔子），透明立绘直接作为桌宠显示；旧皮肤 ID 完全兼容，升级不丢配置
✂️ AI 自动抠图：内置 U-2-Netp 主体分割模型（本地推理），导入带背景的人物 / 动物照片自动识别并抠出主体，全程离线，支持调节抠图强度与自动裁剪透明边缘
💬 生活助手：主动搭话 · 天气播报 · 整点报时，三个独立开关
⚡ 更丝滑、更省电：睡眠时渲染几乎零 GPU 占用、60fps 帧率上限、GPU 光栅化 + 零拷贝合成
🆕 新功能

功能	说明
🐱🦊🐰 全新默认宠物	猫 / 狐狸 / 兔子全新角色立绘，透明背景直接显示
✂️ AI 自动抠图	U-2-Netp 主体分割 + 强度调节，自动裁剪透明边缘，本地离线推理
💬 主动搭话	空闲 10 分钟宠物主动问好（可开关）
☁️ 天气播报	免费 API（IP 定位 + Open-Meteo），点击宠物随机播报日期 / 城市 / 温度 / 天气（可开关）
⏰ 整点报时	每小时整点跳跃 + 气泡报时 + 提示音（可开关）
⚡ 性能优化

睡眠时暂停渲染循环，改为 2fps 慢速动画 → 睡着时 GPU 占用趋近于 0
渲染帧率上限 60fps（不再跟随 144Hz 显示器空转）
启用 enable-gpu-rasterization + enable-zero-copy 合成参数
命中检测改为每帧一次批量读回 + 内存查询，消除鼠标移动时的 GPU 回读微卡顿
📦 其他

打包内置抠图模型与原生依赖（onnxruntime / sharp）；产物：Windows NSIS / macOS DMG+ZIP / Linux AppImage+deb
新增 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/Aceeee2077/Desk-Petrick/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)（U-2-Netp、ONNX Runtime、Sharp 许可说明）
README 与截图全面更新
⚠️ 注意事项

抠图模型（约 4.5MB）随安装包内置，完全离线可用；对纯色背景和人物 / 动物照片效果最佳，复杂背景建议手动处理后导入
旧版 config.json 完全兼容，皮肤 ID 保留但显示新形象


---


📌 v0.2.0 — Brand-new pets · AI background removal · Life Assistant · Performance overhaul
✨ Highlights

Brand-new default pets: 3 new characters (🐱 Cat / 🦊 Fox / 🐰 Rabbit) rendered as transparent art; legacy skin IDs stay fully compatible — upgrading never loses your config
✂️ AI background removal: built-in U-2-Netp salient-object model (local inference) — import a photo of a person or animal with a background and it automatically extracts the subject, fully offline, with adjustable strength and automatic transparent-edge trimming
💬 Life Assistant: proactive chat · weather · hourly chime, three independent toggles
⚡ Smoother & lighter: near-zero GPU usage while sleeping, 60 FPS cap, GPU rasterization + zero-copy compositing
🆕 New Features

Feature	Description
🐱🦊🐰 New default pets	Brand-new Cat / Fox / Rabbit character art, shown directly as transparent pets
✂️ AI background removal	U-2-Netp salient-object segmentation + strength slider, auto-trims transparent edges, offline local inference
💬 Proactive chat	After 10 idle minutes the pet says hi on its own (toggleable)
☁️ Weather	Free APIs (IP geolocation + Open-Meteo); clicking the pet sometimes reports date / city / temperature / conditions (toggleable)
⏰ Hourly chime	The pet jumps, announces the hour in a bubble with a chime (toggleable)
⚡ Performance

Render loop pauses while sleeping, switching to a 2 FPS slow animation → GPU usage drops to ~0 when the pet is asleep
60 FPS render cap (no more vsync-rate waste on 144 Hz displays)
enable-gpu-rasterization + enable-zero-copy compositor switches
Hit-testing now uses one batched readback per frame into memory — removes the per-mousemove GPU stall
📦 Other

Installers bundle the cutout model and native deps (onnxruntime / sharp); builds: Windows NSIS / macOS DMG+ZIP / Linux AppImage+deb
New [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/Aceeee2077/Desk-Petrick/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) (U-2-Netp, ONNX Runtime, Sharp license notices)
README and screenshots fully updated
⚠️ Notes

The cutout model (~4.5 MB) ships inside the installer — fully offline. Works best on solid backgrounds and person/animal photos; complex backgrounds may need manual editing before importing
Existing config.json is fully compatible — skin IDs are kept but display the new art

name: Desk-Petrick v0.1.0
body:
# Desk-Petrick v0.1.0

## English

This is the first public release of Desk-Petrick.

### What's included

- Initial implementation of the desktop application
- Core application functionality
- Basic user interface and workflow
- Initial project structure and configuration
- Project documentation
- Open-source release under the MIT License

### Status

Desk-Petrick is currently in early development.

This release provides the first usable version of the project. Features, interfaces, and implementation details may continue to change as development progresses.

### Feedback

Bug reports, suggestions, and feature requests are welcome.  
Please feel free to open an issue on GitHub.

---

## 中文

这是 Desk-Petrick 的首个公开发布版本。

### 本版本内容

- 完成桌面应用的初始实现
